events.headline: TAIWAN PASSES DEFENCE BUDGET AFTER RECORD DELAY, RETAINS DRONE FUNDING
events.detail: Taiwan parliament ends deadlock, ensuring vital drone programme funding amid rising cross-strait tensions with Beijing.

events.detail: Irán ha hecho valer en Ormuz la tesis clásica de Yves Lacoste de que la geografía es un arma inventada para la guerra

events.headline: US PRESIDENT TRUMP SAYS HE WILL DECLARE STRAIT OF HORMUZ US TERRITORY

events.headline: HOUTHI ATTACK ON PORT KILLS FOUR ERODING TRUCE WITH YEMEN’S GOVERNMENT
